checked: watch-list found: karhutla/haze, crime (narkoba), viral incident (BYD ojol), public services (halal, rice aid), hoaxes, disasters (Labuan Bajo ship)

events.event: Police data presented to Prabowo show 243 individuals and 13 corporations (CNN Indonesia headline says 14) named karhutla suspects, with licence revocation recommended in 23 corporate cases.
events.key_numbers: 243 individual suspects from 286 reports (5,856 ha) · 13 corporate suspects from 100 reports (29,534.99 ha) · 23 corporate cases recommended for licence revocation · 11 suspect corporations hold 209,933 ha of concessions, 11,105.39 ha burned (8 in West Kalimantan, 2 Central, 1 South) · 22 corporations linked to foreign investment · data as of 20 Oct 18:00 WIB
events.why_it_matters: Shows how many people and companies police actually name for the haze, versus the many cases still unresolved.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional terbaru #14; several outlets (Metro TV, Kontan, Suara Merdeka)

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reports NASA flagging very high 2026 fire activity in Kalimantan and Papua, with Indonesian Papua emissions the third-highest on record.
events.key_numbers: Indonesian Papua emissions >35 million tons carbon (3rd after 2015, 1997) · PNG ~32 million tons through 17 Oct · Papua primary forest loss 27,000 ha in 2025 (~2x 2024) · rains expected early Nov
events.why_it_matters: The haze story is bigger in eastern Indonesia than the Sumatra-focused coverage suggests.

events.event: Karhutla spreads on Java and in parks: Gunung Sumbing fire is out with 974 ha affected, while fires hit Way Kambas National Park and BNPB reports hotspots on Java; Jakarta governor Pramono claims pollution fell over two days after weather modification (OMC).
events.key_numbers: Gunung Sumbing 974 ha affected (779 ha on 23 Oct) · OMC 2 days in Jakarta · Menkes warns of PM2.5 danger in Palangka Raya
events.why_it_matters: Smoke and fires are now close to Java's big cities.
events.spreading_evidence: Several items in CNN Indonesia and ANTARA latest lists 25 Oct

events.event: Polri and BNN seize 1.16 tons of ketamine from the foreign-flagged tanker MT Global 168 in the Malacca Strait/Belawan area; eight crew detained, a Taiwanese national reportedly named a suspect.
events.key_numbers: 1.16 tons ketamine · Rp3.48 trillion estimated value · 8 crew detained · ship reportedly turned off AIS
events.why_it_matters: One of the biggest drug seizures in recent years, with DPR pushing police to expose the international network.

events.event: A BYD electric car crashed into several vehicles and ran over online motorcycle-taxi driver Hasan Syukur on Jalan Panglima Polim, Blok M, South Jakarta; the driver, identified as S, was named a suspect on 25 Oct.
events.key_numbers: About 16:48 WIB on 23 Oct · 6 vehicles involved · victim 56, broken left leg, surgery at RS Fatmawati · driver said he panicked, cause not concluded
events.why_it_matters: Viral crash revives debate on EV safety, driver error and who is liable.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional #10 and multiple outlets (Liputan6, Suara, Merdeka) 25 Oct; viral on social media not directly confirmed

events.event: The government, on Prabowo's order, postpones the mandatory halal certification for MSMEs from 18 Oct 2026 to 2028, announced by MSME Minister Maman Abdurrahman.
events.key_numbers: Deadline 18 Oct 2026 moved to 2028 (2 years) · reason: many MSMEs had not reached the target, paperwork burden
events.why_it_matters: Millions of small food sellers get two more years before halal labels become compulsory.

events.event: The government starts distributing rice aid covering October-December 2026 to 33.2 million recipients, said Food Coordinating Minister Zulkifli Hasan.
events.key_numbers: 33.2 million recipients (deciles 1-4) · 30 kg per recipient for 3 months (10 kg/month) · about 1 million tons of rice
events.why_it_matters: A third of households-level aid reaches poorer families just as prices rise.

events.event: Kemenkes denies a viral narrative about an oxygen-cylinder photo and shortness of breath; separately ANTARA's latest hoax debunks (22 Oct) include fake claims that Prabowo announced a replacement for VP Gibran and that people need to be impoverished.
events.key_numbers: ANTARA debunks dated 22 Oct: 3 (Prabowo/Gibran replacement video, 'rakyat perlu dimiskinkan', Febrie Adriansyah freed)
events.why_it_matters: Hoaxes about the president and the vice president keep circulating during the haze and price worries.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA anti-hoax list; Kemenkes denial in humaniora 25 Oct

events.event: Police deploy sonar and drones to search for victims of a sunken boat at Labuan Bajo, and Basarnas recovers the body of a woman believed to be a foreigner at Nyang Nyang beach, Bali.
events.key_numbers: Details of victim count not in sources read
events.why_it_matters: Tourist-area sea safety is in the news again.

events.event: Korlantas Polri starts Operasi Patuh 2026 on 26 October, running to 8 November.
events.why_it_matters: Drivers face stricter traffic checks for two weeks.
